info.name: Shuttle Office Service API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Shuttle Office Service — a bus reservation system with JWT authentication and role-based access control.

Run in order: Auth → Roles → Companies → Buses → Users → Schedules → Reservations.

Environment variables are auto-populated via test scripts.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — no JWT required. Run Register first, then Login.

item.name: Roles
item.description: Role management endpoints. Roles define access levels: admin (0), user (1), guest (2).

item.name: Companies
item.description: Company management endpoints. Companies own buses and employ users.

item.name: Buses
item.description: Bus management endpoints. Buses belong to companies and have schedules.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management endpoints. Users belong to companies and roles.

item.name: Schedules
item.description: Schedule management endpoints. Schedules belong to buses and define departure/arrival times.

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Reservation endpoints. Reservations link users to schedules. No update action — only create, read, delete.
